mustHave: staggered row read from side profile
smaller plates near neck and tail base

experiments.finding: Made separate plates unambiguous, but the output was too block-like and composited for direct final use.
Preserved the blocky plate shapes instead of turning them into convincing bony plate surfaces.
Best plate-recognition tradeoff in this round. It keeps many large separate plates visible, but the plate surfaces remain too smooth and the thagomizer is weak.
Did not materially improve the plate surfaces; mostly preserved or softened the rounded block read.
Made the row more triangular/sail-like and reintroduced round-body drift, so it should not be promoted.

decision.reason: Promoted as the app-first plate-focused review candidate because it improves dorsal-plate readability over the prior primary. It is not approved.
decision.nextRoute: Use a Stegosaurus or stegosaurian plate/thagomizer LoRA, or a stronger reference-conditioned generation route, before attempting approval.
